carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-intensity white spots that are distinct from the larger blob pattern on the main body flank.
